title: 第六章 报到就被带走？
novel_title: 方彻刚刚更新内容(长夜君主)
content_zh: 方青云这一年来，虽然资质所限，在武院排名不高，但是人缘却是绝对的好。朋友一大帮，跟谁都能说得上话。而且为人正派，老实，大家都很喜欢他的性格。虽然限于修为，对于未来如何，也并没有多少人放他在眼里，但是也没必要得罪。毕竟好人一个，老实可靠——这是公认的。而且大家都是习武之人，腿脚也不怎么值钱。所以方青云每天要到武院门口来瞅瞅的时候，于是一大圈子有男有女的，也都跟着来瞅瞅。无所谓，连消化食儿都算不上的运动。正好趁着这段时间老生毕业，新生没来的时候，放松一下。几个女生在追问：“有多帅？比东云玉和武之冰还有花开谢，君何方如何？”这正是白云武院四大天才，也是四大美男，长相身材气质家世资质修为，都是上上品，而且都已经有所成就，名动一方。而其中东云玉，据说明年毕业之后，就可以直接入镇守军团任职。可说前途无量。同样这四人也是无数女武生的瞩目所在。虽然都是武者，但少女的迷离心情与普通女子，也并没有多大区别。方青云回忆了一下，苦笑道：“但说容貌的话，应该差不多，但是，底气，气质，修为，资质，底蕴……”他没说下去，但众人却都明白。长得帅的有的是，但是，长相身材底气气质修为资质底蕴都融于一体的，整个世界有几人？由此可见，这位方青云的表弟，也就是一个长得稍微有点小帅的普通人吧。大家都心里有了数。正在谈论时，却看到武院门口，远远的一个黑衣少年，正缓步而来。正是武院南门。正是早晨，太阳东起，霞光万丈。少年就从霞光中走来，黑色大氅，暗金暗纹，漫步而来，大氅随走动而起伏，折射出迷离光芒，此起彼伏。少年脸庞如玉质，眉如剑，目如深潭，眸似星辰，鼻梁挺直，嘴唇微薄，微微显瘦，长身玉立，发丝轻飘，猿臂蜂腰，长腿便如要将身体撑往星空一般，两腿笔直，腰悬长剑。一身气质，高雅从容。颇有一种‘山崩而色不变，生死而不动容’的安然；又有一种‘千般磨难从容度，万种坎坷一剑开’的锐利。大步而来，便如从万丈霞光中走出来的梦幻之人。在场的几個女子都是目光猛然一下子就亮了起来。“哇……”“啊啊……”“这这这……这……”众位女生都有隐隐感觉：这，就是自己梦中最完美的男人，从自己梦里走了出来。“这是谁？”“这是新生？来报道的？”“啊我死了我死了……”“今年新生嘛？新生有这么出众的人物？”便在这时……身边的方青云动了。“表弟！”方青云很激动，我等到了，我完成了父亲完成的任务了。不用挨揍了。方青云激动，迎上，挥手，高呼。在他身后。一片懵逼的脸。男女同学面面相觑。这就是方青云口中那个‘长得还行、不大懂事、不会说话、惯坏了、没啥规矩、资质一般、气质一般、底气一般、风度一般、底蕴一般、’的表弟？这就是方青云平常提起来就在叹气咬牙发狠说什么‘等他懂事了长大了我非要打一顿出出气’的表弟？所有人看着方青云迎上前去的背影，都有些不解。方师兄，您是不是对‘一般’这两个字有什么误解？就这么看，除了资质和底蕴根本看不出来之外，其他的不管是容貌还是气质，这都妥妥的顶级好吧？甚至，那几个本校的顶级，比如君何方武之冰花开谢等，虽然身上那种‘世家子弟的贵气’很浓，但是，单单从气质来说，却远远比不上这位表弟的从容自若。这是历经风雨的从容不迫；看尽风云的淡然自在。看到方彻的这种从容，众位同学甚至有一种看到了校长副校长那等巅峰人物的感觉。宠物不惊，看庭前花开花谢；去留无意，观天上云卷云舒。淡看生死，笑对风云。这种人，任何一人走出来都是出类拔萃，无双无对！……那边，方彻已经与方青云凑在一起，笑容和煦亲切：“表哥，等久了吧？”方青云连连点头：“还好还好……哎？你叫我啥？”方青云有些震惊，眼睛都瞪圆了。这还是我那个说话尖酸刻薄，一句话出来就让人想要操刀子拿棍子的表弟？怎么这么有礼貌？方彻诧异：“叫你表哥啊，还能叫你啥？我叫你一声大舅你敢答应么？”来了来了！他来了！这句话熟悉的噎人味道让方青云顿时露出欣慰的笑：“你果然是我表弟！刚才看到我还以为变了个人。”“……”方彻无语。说话间，方青云身后的数十人已经将两人包围了三圈。一个个眼神中充满了好奇。尤其是女生们，人数虽然不多只有四五个，但是眼中的炙热，几乎将方彻融化掉。甚至对于这种目光，感觉难以招架，有一种‘再不跑就会被吃掉’的危机感。
content_en: In the past year, Fang Qingyun, although his qualifications were limited and his ranking in the martial arts academy was not high, his popularity was absolutely good.I have a lot of friends and I can talk to everyone.He is also a decent and honest person, and everyone likes his character very much.Although he was limited to his cultivation, not many people paid much attention to his future, but there was no need to offend him.After all, he is a good person, honest and reliable - this is recognized.Moreover, everyone is a martial arts practitioner, and their legs and feet are not very valuable.So when Fang Qingyun came to the entrance of the martial arts academy every day to take a look, a large circle of men and women also came to take a look.It doesn't matter, digesting food isn't even considered exercise.It just so happens that during this period, the old students are graduating and the new students are not here to relax.Several girls are asking: "How handsome are you? Compared with Dong Yunyu and Wu Zhibing, and the flowers are blooming and withering, how about you?" These are the four geniuses of Baiyun Martial Arts Academy, and they are also the four most handsome men. They are all top-grade in appearance, figure, temperament, family background, qualifications and cultivation, and they have already achieved something and are famous.Among them, Dongfang Yunyu is said to be able to directly join the garrison after graduating next year.It can be said that the future is promising.These four people are also the focus of countless female martial arts students.Although they are both warriors, the girl's confused mood is not much different from that of ordinary women.Fang Qingyun recalled it and said with a wry smile: "But in terms of appearance, it should be about the same, but confidence, temperament, cultivation, qualifications, background..." He did not continue, but everyone understood.There are many handsome people, but how many people in the world have the same looks, body, confidence, temperament, and qualifications?It can be seen from this that Fang Qingyun's cousin is just an ordinary person who looks a little handsome.Everyone has an idea.While they were talking, they saw a young man in black coming slowly from a distance at the entrance of the martial arts academy.It is the south gate of Wuyuan.It is morning, the sun rises in the east, and the glow is brilliant.The young man walked out of the glow, strolling in a black cloak with dark golden patterns. The cloak undulated as he walked, reflecting the blurred light, one after another.The young man's face is like jade, his eyebrows are like swords, his eyes are like deep pools, his eyes are like stars, his nose is straight, his lips are thin, and he is slightly thinner. He has a long body, light hair, ape-like arms and wasp waist, and long legs as if to support his body into the starry sky. His legs are straight, and a long sword hangs from his waist.His temperament is elegant and calm.There is quite a kind of peace that "the color remains unchanged despite the landslide, and the face remains unmoved by life and death"; there is also a kind of sharpness that "can handle thousands of hardships calmly, and overcome all kinds of ups and downs with one sword".Taking long strides, one looks like a dreamy person stepping out of the rays of light.The eyes of several women present suddenly lit up."Wow..." "Ahhh..." "This, this, this... this..." All the girls had a vague feeling: This is the most perfect man in their dreams, walking out of their dreams."Who is this?" "Is this a freshman? Here to report?" "Ah, I'm dead, I'm dead..." "Are there new students this year? Are there such outstanding people among the freshmen?" At this moment... Fang Qingyun beside him moved."Cousin!" Fang Qingyun was very excited, I waited, I completed the task that my father completed.No more beatings.Fang Qingyun was excited, greeted him, waved and shouted.behind him.A confused face.The male and female classmates looked at each other.Is this the cousin that Fang Qingyun said was ‘okay-looking, not very sensible, unable to speak, spoiled, has no rules, has average qualifications, average temperament, average confidence, average demeanor, and average background’?This is the cousin that Fang Qingyun usually sighs and grits his teeth when he mentions it, saying, "When he becomes sensible and grows up, I have to beat him up to vent his anger"?Everyone looked at Fang Qingyun's back and felt a little puzzled.Senior Brother Fang, do you have any misunderstanding about the word 'general'?Looking at it this way, except for the qualifications and background that can’t be seen at all, everything else, whether it’s appearance or temperament, is top-notch, right?Even some of the top students in the school, such as Jun He Fangwu, etc., although they have a strong sense of 'nobility as a child of aristocratic families', in terms of temperament, they are far inferior to this cousin's calmness.This is the calmness that has gone through the wind and rain; the calmness that has seen all the wind and clouds.Seeing Fang Che's calmness, the students even felt as if they were seeing top figures like the principal and vice principal.The pet is not surprised, watching the flowers blooming and fading in front of the court; leaving or leaving without care, watching the clouds rolling and relaxing in the sky.Look at life and death lightly, smile at the wind and cloud.Anyone who comes out of this kind of person will be outstanding, unparalleled and unmatched!...over there, Fang Che was already together with Fang Qingyun, smiling warmly and cordially: "Cousin, have you been waiting for a long time?" Fang Qingyun nodded repeatedly: "Okay, okay... Hey? What did you call me?" Fang Qingyun was a little shocked, and his eyes were rounded.Is this my cousin who speaks harshly and makes people want to use knives and sticks when he speaks?Why are you so polite?Fang Che was surprised: "I call you cousin, what else can I call you? If I call you uncle, do you dare to agree?" Come on!He's coming!The familiar choking taste of these words made Fang Qingyun smile with relief: "You are indeed my cousin! I thought I had changed when I saw him just now." "..." Fang Che was speechless.While talking, dozens of people behind Fang Qingyun had surrounded the two people three times.Their eyes were full of curiosity.Especially the girls, although there were only four or five in number, the heat in their eyes almost melted Fang Che.Even facing this kind of gaze, I feel it is difficult to resist, and there is a sense of crisis that 'if you don't run, you will be eaten'.
title_en: Chapter 6: Being taken away upon registration?
